items.title: The Open-Sourcing of DeepSeek Harness Opens the Door to Modular, Unbundled AI Agent Infrastructure
items.blurb: DeepSeek has released a developer preview of DeepSeek Harness (dsh), an open-source execution runtime for building autonomous AI agents. The software features a micro-kernel architecture with modular plugins for various functional units.

items.title: Whatsapp Tests on Device ML for Scam Detection with Privacy Preserving Analytics
items.blurb: WhatsApp is testing Scam Alert in limited beta, using on device machine learning to detect potential scam messages from non contacts.

items.title: Presentation: Why Fetch When You Can Sync? Building Local-First Apps on a Sync Engine Architecture
items.blurb: James Arthur shares why sync is the next frontier in frontend architecture. He explains how extending reactivity to the server with Electric and TanStack DB replaces imperative fetching with declarative data bindings.

items.title: LilScript makes js libraries 5-15% smaller
items.blurb: LilScript is a typed, compression-first language that compiles into js and sometimes into exec(will be more stable in future).

items.title: How Code in the Age of Artificial Intelligence Becomes Write-Only and Disposable
items.blurb: Artificial intelligence (AI) makes all code write-only,. It’s too dense to read, and tests define the behaviour and become the documentation. Code is also disposable; it becomes easier to rewrite than to debug.

items.title: Don't Paste the AI, please
items.blurb: If someone asks you a question, paste your answer — not the chatbot's.
